examples.en: The kids are playing with a ball on the playground.
We broke a window while playing with a ball.
Ball games are more fun the more people there are.
Do you want to go to the park to play ball?

examples.ko: 어릴 때는 매일 골목에서 공놀이로 하루를 보냈어요.
examples.en: As a kid, I spent every day playing ball in the alley.

examples.ko: 공놀이에 푹 빠져서 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
examples.en: I was so absorbed in the ball game that I lost track of time.

explain: 축구나 야구처럼 규칙이 있는 경기보다 공을 가지고 가볍게 노는 느낌이에요. 보통 '공놀이를 하다'로 써요.
explain_en: It feels like casual play with a ball, rather than a rule-based sport such as soccer or baseball. It usually appears as '공놀이를 하다'.

examples.en: We held an impromptu singing contest at the party.
I took part in our village's singing contest.
The first prize at the singing contest is a refrigerator.
Grandmother won a prize at the singing contest.
We decided to have a singing contest at the company dinner.
A singing contest is being broadcast this evening.

explain: 동네 잔치나 모임, 방송에서 여러 사람이 차례로 나와 노래를 부르는 대회예요. '노래자랑에 나가다', '노래자랑을 열다'처럼 말해요. 전문 가수를 뽑는 오디션보다 가볍고 즐거운 분위기예요.
explain_en: It is an event, at a village festival, gathering or on TV, where people take turns singing. You say '노래자랑에 나가다' or '노래자랑을 열다'. It has a lighter, more fun mood than an audition to choose professional singers.

examples.en: Our class is preparing for the relay.

examples.ko: 릴레이는 바통을 정확히 넘기는 게 중요해요.
examples.en: In a relay, passing the baton correctly is important.

examples.ko: 릴레이 경기에서 마지막 주자가 일등을 했어요.
examples.en: In the relay race, the last runner came first.
I dropped the baton in the relay but ran to the end.

examples.ko: 친구들이 릴레이로 편지를 써서 선생님께 드렸어요.
examples.en: My friends wrote a letter in turns and gave it to the teacher.

examples.ko: 우리 동아리는 릴레이 소설을 쓰기로 했어요.
examples.en: Our club decided to write a relay novel.

explain: 운동 경기에서는 '이어달리기'라고도 해요. 'SNS 릴레이', '릴레이 소설'처럼 여러 사람이 차례로 이어 가는 일 앞에 붙여요.
explain_en: In sports it is also called '이어달리기'. It is put in front of things many people continue in turn, like 'SNS 릴레이' and '릴레이 소설'.

en: to screen; to show (a film or program)

examples.en: The theater is showing a new movie.
The school screened a documentary.

examples.ko: 그 영화는 오늘 몇 시에 상영하나요?
examples.en: What time does that movie show today?

examples.ko: 영화를 상영하는 동안 휴대폰을 꺼 주세요.
examples.en: Please turn off your phone while the film is playing.

examples.ko: 공원에서 매주 금요일에 영화를 상영해 줘요.
examples.en: They show a movie in the park every Friday.
They will start showing that movie tomorrow.

explain: 극장이나 행사에서 영화를 틀어 줄 때 써요. 집에서 영화를 볼 때는 '상영' 대신 '틀다'나 '보다'를 써요. 연극이나 콘서트는 '공연하다'예요.
explain_en: It is used when a theater or event plays a film. At home you would say 틀다 or 보다 rather than 상영하다. For plays and concerts, use 공연하다.

dis.h: show a film at a theater

p.n: 상영하다 is only for showing films or programs, so 놀다 does not fit.

examples.en: I play chess with a friend every weekend.
Chess has rules that are a bit difficult.
I learned how to play chess from my father.
My younger sibling won a prize at a chess tournament.
My hobbies are chess and reading.
The pieces disappeared from the chessboard one by one.

explain: 체스는 '두다'와 같이 써요. '체스를 두다'처럼 말해요. 바둑이나 장기도 '두다'를 쓰고, 카드 게임은 '치다'를 써요.
explain_en: Chess goes with the verb '두다': '체스를 두다'. Go (바둑) and Korean chess (장기) also use '두다', while card games use '치다'.

examples.ko: 어릴 때 동네 형과 팔씨름 대결을 한 적이 있어요.
examples.en: When I was little, I once had an arm-wrestling match with an older boy from the neighborhood.
In arm wrestling, wrist strength is important.
We arm wrestled for a bet and I lost.
I want to beat my father at arm wrestling.

examples.ko: 점심 내기로 팔씨름 한 판 할래요?
examples.en: Want to arm wrestle once for lunch?
As soon as the arm wrestling ended, my arm was tingling.

explain: '팔씨름을 하다'라고 하고, 한 번 겨루는 건 '한 판'으로 세요. '씨름'은 한국 전통 레슬링인데, '팔씨름'은 팔만으로 힘을 겨루는 놀이예요.
explain_en: You say '팔씨름을 하다', and one round is counted as '한 판'. '씨름' is traditional Korean wrestling, while '팔씨름' is a contest of strength using just the arm.
